summary: Department access reviews now run inside PIM Manager, reviewing people rather than groups, with no extra Microsoft licence.

new.title: Reviews cover a department's people
new.text: Each round lists every admin account of the department with the access it holds. Reviewers choose Keep or Remove per person on My people.

new.title: Two approvers, parallel or serial
new.text: In parallel both decide and any Remove wins. In serial approver 1 decides first and approver 2 has the final word.

new.title: Unanswered reviews are chased
new.text: After the due date reviewers get a weekly reminder three times, then alert recipients are told and the round closes. Undecided people keep their access.

new.title: Senior administrators can override
new.text: A senior administrator can decide any open person on the Access reviews page. Every decision is recorded in the audit trail.

new.title: Remove always goes through approval
new.text: Remove never takes access away directly. It raises a removal request that a PIM administrator approves.
